cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.

mechanism: A copies counting taps as a log-opening convention and covers by obtaining the whole row before accepting the suspiciously important answer.
confusable: D174 conceals priority among missing data; D172 seeks endorsement rather than factual completeness.
comparison: Deflecting timeline suspicion versus helping retrieve difficult mileage and fuel records.
seedUse: Keep B easier driver answer and physical retrieval cost as the cause of A extra effort.
